device_entry.name: SMC40步进电机控制器
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 这是一台用于驱动步进电机的运动控制器，可按设定方向和角度实现精密旋转定位，适合实验室中样品台、光学元件或机械部件的角度调整与重复转动。
device_entry.description_en: This is a motion controller for driving a stepper motor. It provides precise angular positioning with configurable direction and angle, and is suitable in laboratories for rotating sample mounts, optical components, or other mechanical parts.

schema.description: 获取/设置旋转方向（顺时针或逆时针）
schema.description_en: Get/set the rotation direction (clockwise or counterclockwise).

schema.description: 将位置归零或回到零位
schema.description_en: Zero the position or return to the zero position.
Wait for the current operation to complete.
Trigger the device to execute an action.

schema.description: 按指定方向旋转指定角度，可选择等待完成
schema.description_en: Rotate by a specified angle in the selected direction, optionally waiting for completion.
